one sheet-metal base flange, ReverseThickness=true; base Sketch is connected straight U with optional far outward Return

same near-Wall height and same far outer contour depth (return wall H+t equals bare wall H)

equations.qn: qf - (sf-sn); if this enters loser near Bend, constrain qn=t_loser
equations.loser_far_return: preserve outer contour to cover outer Return tip; relief transition at q=W_loser+g
equations.cover_wall_web: near end q=t_loser; Web seam uses (sn,qn)->(sf,qf); farWall q=W_loser

equations.near_bend_gap_guard: loser: s>=-g, q<=t_loser+g, same tangent depths
